Rajiv — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Quick answers inline, then proposed next steps below.

Commercial split (high level):
- Referral (no billing handoff): 20% of first-year subscription ARR for the customer you introduced, paid on invoice net-30 after customer's first payment.
- Reseller (IntelliOps invoices, Redwood delivers): 30% rev-share for first 12 months, then steps to 15% thereafter. Reseller deals need a revenue routing setup and an MSA addendum.

Proof-of-intro / lead protection:
- We typically accept 120 days as the lead-protection window from the date of first documented intro (email thread or form submission). We also accept a short "proof-of-intro packet" (email + client confirmation) to be uploaded to our Partner Portal.

Proposal attached: redwood-connector-commercial-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet) includes examples and sample contract language.

Suggested next steps:
1) Review the attached proposal and tell me which path you prefer (referral vs reseller).
2) If reseller, confirm whether IntelliOps wants to handle billing (we'll route invoices) or have Redwood bill and pay a commission.
3) We'll hash out a short DocuSign addendum for the proof-of-intro and initial 12-month ramp terms — I can send a draft.

I'm available Tue 2–4pm PT for a 30-min call; Ben (cc'd) can join to discuss revenue routing.

Thanks — happy to make this straightforward.

--
